body.purpose: Dense, legible operational content and controls.

heading.purpose: Compact hierarchy for report and dialog titles.

mono.purpose: Codes, compact figures, and source identifiers.

shadows.name: soft-surface
shadows.purpose: Resting white data surfaces on the pastel canvas.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Use for the strongest local action only.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: .4rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--action-primary); color: var(--text-on-brand); font: 600 .82rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-snappy); } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: var(--action-primary-hover); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-action-primary:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact operational field with visible focus and control geometry.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 34px; padding: .34rem .55rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-default); color: var(--text-primary); font: .82rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--action-primary); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Scope Chip
components.description: A compact capsule for filter scope or short metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 28px; padding: .25rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface-default); color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 .82rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--action-primary); color: var(--action-primary-hover); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action-primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Data Surface
components.description: A peer-level report, filter, or data container.
components.html: Phạm vi dữ liệuĐã đồng bộ gần nhất
components.css: .ds-surface { display: grid; gap: .35rem; padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-surface); background: var(--surface-default); color: var(--text-primary); font: .88rem var(--font-sans); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); } .ds-surface span { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: .82rem; }

components.name: Status Notice
components.description: A compact semantic notice that does not rely on color alone.
components.html: Chú ý: Dữ liệu đang theo phạm vi đã chọn.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: .85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--status-warning-bg); color: var(--status-warning-fg); font: .83rem/1.45 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Sidebar Edge
components.description: The fixed navigation shell; its partial radius is an attachment exception, not a card radius.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: grid; gap: .65rem; width: 190px; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0 24px 24px 0; background: var(--action-primary-deep); color: var(--text-on-brand); font: .85rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-sidebar button { padding: .5rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sidebar button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-sidebar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: GHN KAS is an operations workspace, not a marketing surface. It should make scope, freshness, risk, and the next drill-down legible at a glance. The visual language is airy and pastel-blue, while the density and wording remain practical enough for repeated daily analysis.
keyCharacteristics: One shared shape scale for repeated UI roles.
Color never carries status or data meaning without labels, values, or structure.

rules.name: The One-Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies the principal interactive path on a local surface. Orange does not replace semantic warning/error treatment and is not a second primary button color.

rules.name: The Role, Not the File Rule
rules.body: A new card inherits surface, and a new form field inherits control, regardless of which CSS file or report module owns it. Do not introduce literal radii for a repeated UI role.

rules.name: The Legacy Radius Rule
rules.body: Existing literal 18px, 20px, 24px, 8px, and similar values are migration candidates, not additions to the design scale.

dos: Do use var(--radius-surface) for a new card, modal, filter bar, report panel, or peer data container.
Do use var(--radius-control) for a field or compact rectangular control.
Do use var(--radius-pill) only when the component is intentionally capsule-shaped.
donts: Don't add a literal border-radius to a repeated component role when a radius token exists.
Don't make two peer white surfaces appear to have different curvature without a containment/attachment reason.
Don't use a pill merely to make every control look alike.
